notes.title: NUCLEAR NIGHTMARE TOWER ISLAND UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Features:[/p][p]- New Map: Tower Island[/p][p]Tower Island is a smaller map focused on larger underground areas, designed to be an option for those with smaller friend groups. Tower Island introduces a level of claustrophobia never seen before in Nuclear Nightmare. Additionally the lighting has been improved on this map with less fog in the day time. If requested I may consider changing this to be the case on all of the maps.[/p][p][/p][p]- New enemy: Slug Queen[/p][p] The Slug Queen is a unkillable boss enemy similar to the Apex Predator except it has vision making it smarter than the Apex. Additionally the stun lasts a lot shorter, bullets and fire will slow down the enemy with a maximum down time of 3-4 seconds. It is better to avoid this enemy with stealth. The Slug Queen is exclusive to the Tower Island map. There is no option to disable this enemy because of how small Tower Island is (Open to changing this if requested and bringing to other maps such as Low Island)[/p][p][/p][p]- FSR Support: Runtime frame generation for all GPUs (Huge performance boosts)[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes + Improvements + Major Changes[/p][list][*][p]All stun locks removed, enemies now run away after attacking the player[/p][/*][*][p]Stealth based enemies, all enemies now search and roam based on sight and sound, no enemies know your exact location and will only stalk your general location. They also now need a direct line of sight in order to see you.[/p][/*][*][p]Head bob significantly decreased on player camera[/p][/*][*][p]Hoodies overlapping with first person view fixed,[/p][/*][*][p]Water not causing deaths on Low Island,[/p][/*][*][p]New jumping animations[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered fog on The Forest map & Low island,[/p][/*][*][p]Lasers from trip mines sticking through walls fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Landscape flickering on Low island fixed (Specifically around Oil Plant)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated main menu graphics & animation[/p][/*][*][p]Crouching smoothly interpolates now instead of the sharp snap from before[/p][/*][*][p]Hover over the satellite icon to see number of levers and status of the satellite (on/off)[/p][/*][*][p]Shooting weapon camera shake effect + more realistic sound attention effects for gun shots[/p][/*][*][p]AI can now more accurately can track down vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Footsteps lagging behind the player fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly turned down monster footsteps[/p][/*][*][p]Glowsticks made dropable, if you pick a glowstick and then drop it using Q it will continue to stay lit[/p][/*][*][p]All enemies made distracted by flares but will ignore a flare over sight of a player[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered sniper recoil when hip firing[/p][/*][*][p]Changed item spawn probabilities to slightly favor other guns and ammo (too many revolvers)[/p][/*][*][p]Mp5 buffed[/p][/*][*][p]Attack music loop fixed and will only play during an attack rather than on sight[/p][/*][*][p]Player night vision adjusted to be slightly brighter and turn on in interiors no matter what time of day[/p][/*][*][p]Prompt to save world settings if name is empty[/p][/*][*][p]Issue with microphone UI disappearing when dying + made more intuitive [/p][/*][*][p]Removal of path tracing causing crashes on non rtx cards[/p][/*][*][p]Doors standing up right after being broken fixed[/p][/*][*][p]If interacting with a door at the same time as another player caused your arms to be permanently facing downwards fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Flare does not drop when selecting item with hotkeys fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized level streaming to have a less noticeable stutter + now no longer waits for the render thread to complete before executing the game thread (should fix a specific crash related to this)[/p][/*][*][p]World setting hints, hover over the ? icon to see a full description of what each world setting option means/does[/p][/*][*][p]You can still hear footsteps of a dead person after dying from laser trip mine fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Invisible enemy bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Emoting, whistling, or pointing while as snowcat passenger fixed[/p][/*][*][p]No longer can spawn as a playable enemy in the water[/p][/*][*][p]Players not being able to control bodies when reinforced may happen when too many users respawned at once or when too many die at once fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved player models, not to be confused with the fully reworked ones for forest part II, this improvement gets rid of some weird stretching and hoodies not wrapping around player’s faces or hands correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded from UE5.4 to UE5.6, claims to improve performance overall, and fix certain crashes on AMD cards, as well as improving graphical fidelity at the same time[/p][p]Note: notes.title: THE FOREST UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1][b]NUCLEAR NIGHTMARE: THE FOREST UPDATE 🌲❄️[/b][/h1][p][b]Major Content Drop | Now Live[/b][/p][p]Brace yourselves, survivors. A frozen island of death awaits. Introducing our most intense and atmospheric update yet: [b]THE FOREST[/b]. This isn’t just a new map — it’s a whole new nightmare.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]NEW CONTENT & FEATURES[/b][/p][h3][b]🌲 New Map: The Forest[/b][/h3][p]Explore a haunting snow-covered island located in the east Siberian Sea, an area buried in white silence and fear. You'll need stealth, speed, and precision — especially on Nightmare difficulty — to make it out alive.[/p][h3][b]👁️‍🗨️ New Enemy: The Apex Predator [i](Exclusive to The Forest)[/i][/b][/h3][p]Our first ever [b]Boss-Class Enemy[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Cannot be killed.

[/p][/*][*][p]Can only be stunned. (30 - 60 seconds until regaining consciousness)

[/p][/*][*][p]Spawns once randomly during a match

[/p][/*][*][p]Hunts purely by sound. (No sight capability)
 Use stealth to survive. Sneak... or stay frozen in place. One wrong step, and you're the prey.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌊 Swimming & Breakable Icebergs [i](Forest-Exclusive Mechanics)[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Entering water rapidly drains your warmth — death by freezing is real.

[/p][/*][*][p]Cross icebergs to survive, but beware — they crack and shatter the longer you stand on them.
 Every step is a gamble.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎵 New Soundtrack Additions[/b][/h3][p]Brand-new environmental music and tension stingers for [b]The Forest[/b], designed to enhance immersion and keep you on edge.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🔧 FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Temporarily removed flamethrower stalling mechanic[/b] — pending overhaul with new animations.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed flashlight drop bug[/b] when holding the revolver.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Massive performance upgrades[/b] — including AI, lighting, reflections, fog, particle systems, dynamic sky, materials, and more. Huge boost for Low Island and overall framerate stability across the entire game.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Navigation Overhaul[/b] — AI now:

[/p][list][*][p]Follows the fastest paths

[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamically reroutes when stuck/ unable to find player

[/p][/*][*][p]Can swim in Forest Map

[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]helicopter reinforcement spawn bug[/b] in cutscenes for clients, helicopter would appear under the map.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphical fidelity improvements[/b] — decreased overall sharpness, and fog scattering effect.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with [b]missing heads[/b] when leech attacks + first-person animations were disabled.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessories on skins[/b] now appear correctly in cutscenes.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Gas Canister explosion replication bug[/b].

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map replay selection added[/b] — pick and revisit maps on mission failed/won screen.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic main menu screen[/b] — updates to reflect selected map.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Mimic barricade bug[/b] causing crash on pickup.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]GPU crashes & game/render thread stalls[/b] — smoother gameplay guaranteed.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hitbox system overhauled[/b] — better accuracy across all weapons.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bullets being [b]blocked by certain props[/b] (e.g. huskies).

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire system optimized[/b] — added pooling + fixed desync issues.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed snowmobiles [b]triggering mission failed[/b] in evac zones.

[/p][/*][*][p]Open doors [b]no longer block player movement[/b].

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Photograph objective UI now displays[/b] your image during animations.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Pickaxe disappearing bug[/b].

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🔮 WHAT'S NEXT?[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Forest Part 2[/b] is on the way, featuring:

[/p][list][*][p]Overhauled [b]player models[/b] with real first-person hands

[/p][/*][*][p]New enemy type: [b]The Cultist

[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Expanded lore and events tied to the Forest

[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additionally, our Technical Artist has wrapped another upcoming map — [b]Facility-Based[/b]. We might sneak this into Part 2 if the timeline permits.

[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re listening closely to your feedback. This update wouldn’t be possible without the community — keep sending us bug reports, ideas, and chaos. See you in the snow, survivors. Stay quiet. Stay alive.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][i]“Sound is death. Step carefully.”

notes.title: Nuclear Nightmare V2.4 / Resurrection Finale Update
notes.notes:
Features/Major Changes:
- Revamped/remastered underground location lighting & textures
- Vehicle Horns (Press H)
- New flamethrower sounds + Flamethrower stall logic: If the flamethrower is under 50% it may randomly stall when trying to turn it on for the first time.
- Reworked playable enemy: Right click to lunge has been replaced with ability to override attack cooldown, paired with a new model and animations. Disabled ability to be reinforced if you spawn as a playable enemy, however never spawn playable enemy has been turned off by default in world settings to avoid confusion)
- New head spider model + head spiders scream when burnt!
- You can now hold a flashlight and revolver or flare gun at the same time + new flashlight model & animations
- Persistent gas stations & soda machines across entire map (This means you can't load back in a area you have already been to and use the soda machine again or have the gas station fuel level reset)
- Damage Overhaul (Includes improved hitboxes & changes to how damage is dealt to enemies) 
- Probability item spawns (Items are not just spawned completely randomly anymore, each item has a probability to spawn. For example powerful weapons like snipers and other ammo types are more rare to find than a gas canister. With this being the case, items like revolvers and mp5s were given a significant buff)
- Mimics drop items

Fixes/Improvements:
- Faster camera animation rotation during cutscenes
- Adjusted streaming granularity for lower end pcs
- Revolver aiming improved
- Flare gun aiming improved
- Removed lumen hardware ray tracing (Significant performance boost)
- Overall rendering optimizations
- Dog death ragdolls improved
- Dropping Ammo causes ammo to go in negatives if spamming the drop button (fixed)
- Item hp bar UI change
- Inventory UI not appearing for clients with high latency (fixed)
- Snowcat glass flashing fix
- Laser is droppable when not placed correctly (automatically snaps to the ground)
- New slaughter house textures
- Updated evac computer UI
- New pickaxe model
- New husk sounds
- Text chat added back + mimics talking in text chat
- Bug stopping playable enemy spawning in a regular match (fixed)
- Playable enemy damage not being handled correctly as client (fixed)
- Eye monster difficulty lowered
- invincible mimic bug (fixed)
- Instance of one player having the view of another’s body but controlling their body when reinforced
- Incorrect snowmobile temperature (fixed)
- Dropping items inside of the snowcat causing strange physics (fixed)
- New helicopter sounds
- helicopter monitor font moving too fast (fixed)
- Optimized fire particle systems
- Gun crosshair not centered correctly (fixed)
- When a door would get destroyed but barricade stays in place (fixed)
- Drilling Rig: One of the buildings had a flying pillar (fixed)
- Pyramid classified at med bay falling through the table (fixed)
- Revolver buff
- Flamethrower flames don't point towards center of screen (fixed)
- Mimic attacking player in a snowcat causing a strange rotation bug (fixed)
- Voice chat input gain doesn’t get applied from settings at the start of the game (fixed)
- Opening settings to fast at the start of the match causes soft lock (fixed)
- Removed debuff on gps navigator

[b]Why is this update called Resurrection Finale?[/b]
We are moving on to putting all hands on deck to hopefully get the forest map out sometime in July and feel this update was solid enough to leave off on while we switch all focus on to the forest map. It also marks the end of QOL/Revamps to the current version of the game. 

[b]Does this mean we are done bug fixing and optimizing?[/b]
OF COURSE NOT! It just means as soon as the forest is out we will come back to optimizing and bug fixing. Unless of course it is very pressing such as a larger game breaking bug.

[b]Does this mean the current weapon system/damage system isn't changing anymore?[/b]
OF COURSE NOT! I think moving to the improved aiming was a step in the right direction, however the problem is balancing the difficulty and horror of the game when this change was made. I am well aware this is a horror game, and not the next COD zombies. So in this most recent update I have introduced ammo rarity hopefully making you think carefully about each shot. Too easy? Too hard? Too boring? Let us know in the comments or discussions!

IF YOU ARE EXPERIENCING GAME THREAD WAITING FOR RENDER THREAD CRASHES/FREEZES AFTER RESURRECTION UPDATES:
Please delete your engine.ini file inside of /AppData/Local/NuclearNightmare/Saved/Config/Windows/
For some strange reason some users engine.ini files corrupted causing strange freezes after recent updates. Fortunately a simple delete of this file should fix things up. If not please let me know in the comments so we can look into it further.

notes.title: Resurrection Update
notes.notes:
❄️ Resurrection Update – “Cold Reboot”
Incoming transmission… major systems overhaul. Threat intelligence updated. Deployment imminent.

🔧 Core Features & Overhauls
- Snowcats Remastered: Full physics overhaul. Handling tightened, Speed Increased, Stability Improved.
- Enemy Snowcat Attacks: You are not safe anymore — they can pull you out...
- Husky Guard Mode 2.0: Instant reaction to nearby threats. Guard mode now means guard, just remember to feed it "bacon"...
- Mimics with Items: Mimics can now disguise themselves while holding in-world items. Stay alert!
- No Weapons Mode: Tactical restraint — challenge yourself with no weapon spawns and newly added stealth mechanics.
- Flares as Distractions: Use flares to misdirect enemies. New stealth utility added.

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements
- Extraction Mission Fail Bug: Missions now complete correctly upon successful extraction.
- Helicopter: Now faster, more fuel-efficient, and no longer explodes mid-air without reason.
- Snowcat Exit Glitch: Fixed falling through terrain when disembarking.
- Grenade Radius vs. Dogs: Reduced overkill — dogs now survive more realistic proximity.
- Invisible Players: Fixed rare bug causing players to become invisible.
- Husky Behavior: No longer idle when attacked. They react like true guardians.
- Door Barricades: More reliable fall behavior when disarmed.
- Snowmobile Exit Speed Bug: No more getting stuck dismounting at high speeds.
- Mimic Hitbox Tuning: Improved accuracy and detection.
- Mimic Theme Music: Audio cue added — if you hear it, run.
- Night Vision in Snowcat: Visuals now function correctly.
- Pickaxe Switching Bug: Hotkeys now reliably toggle flashlight and glow stick.
- Auto-Rotation Fix: Helicopter cameras now reset to default position properly.
- Music Bugs: Tracks now play and end as intended — no more eerie silence.
- Enemy AI: No longer ignores active generators.
- Reinforcement Spawns: Fixed non-spawning issue (stuck on snow screen).
- Reinforcement Notifications: Players now get alerts when backup is inbound.
- Leeches AI: They now actively seek and attack players.
- Radio G-Key Fix: G now correctly interacts when radio is equipped.
- MP5 Centering: Adjusted weapon position for better alignment.

🧊 “The snow is quiet… too quiet. Something’s changed out there.” – Unknown Field Operator

⚠️We apologize for the delay in updates, for more information join our discord. Development is once again continuing as normal.

notes.title: THE BASE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello researchers. The AISF has released new documents regarding potential changes in the arctic environments.
Mother nature has brought a lot of changes and fixes for you all, so lets dive right in.

📢 - **Overview**
- New mimic enemy.
- New weapon, the MP5!
- New vehicle. The Snowcat, granted by the AISF.
- New helicopter model.
- Randomized objectives.
- Barricade item.
- Movable lasers.
- Enemy & vehicle frequency world settings.

🛠️ - **Fixes**
- Certain audio not working with volume sliders.
- Bullets can no longer kill their producer.
- Improved crosshair that shows where your bullet will land.
- Creatures have been gene spliced to remove invisibility.
- Fixed an issue where you would be unable to interact with objects that take time to complete (like generators).
- The helicopter no longer slides.
- Perk machine *should* no longer soft-lock players.
- Perk machine will allow a re-roll if cut by power.
- Perk machine no longer displays "re-roll" if you do not have enough perks equipped to re-roll.
- Perk machine infinite re-roll glitch. (cheaters.)
- Perk text improvements.
- Windows and other glass materials no longer visible through fog.
- Ammo boxes have been optimized from 50k polygons to 50.
- Laser keyboard sound issues.
- Addressed music overlap and music persisting after enemy death.
- SIGNIFICANT AI optimizations (10x in some cases).
- Vehicles now teleport you outside the door when leaving, as opposed to clipping you inside.
- Rare issue where players could not use the laptop after respawning.
- Fixed an occasional issue where the perk save file could get corrupted.

⬆️ - **Changes and Additions**
- The sniper scope now uses your screen, increasing performance greatly.
- Added new damage framework internally, allowing us to make objects do things when hit with ease.
- Lasers are based on distance for length.
- Red canisters can now be shot to explode.
- The generator can be turned off with a pickaxe.
- More UI improvements, should scale properly on larger screens.
- Dead AI's should no longer function after 60 seconds.
- Extraction has been improved.
- Upon being called, the helicopter has a 60 second "landing period"
- After this landing period, the helicopter waits for 5 minutes.
- If half the researchers enter the circle in this 5 minute, the timer goes to one minute.
- At the end of the minute, all researchers who are outside the circle will not evacuate.
- Nightmare detector has been changed to pair with the Motion Detector
- When the motion detector senses an enemy, it displays the enemy with x-ray.
- The x-ray view only lasts as long as the beep lasts.
- The beeper does not work when holstered.

notes.title: Nuclear Nightmare Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[b]Thank You for Supporting Nuclear Nightmare! Early Access is Just the Beginning![/b]

We’re beyond thrilled to finally share Nuclear Nightmare in Early Access! Your enthusiasm and support keep us motivated, and we can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been working on.

[b]What makes Nuclear Nightmare stand out?[/b] Imagine an Arctic wasteland where danger lies beneath every snowdrift. You’ll soar through the skies in helicopters, zoom across the frozen tundra on snowmobiles, and battle for survival in intense, match-based gameplay. Your mission? Collect classified materials while outrunning the unstoppable Black Goo virus and the nightmarish creatures it spawns.

But that’s just the beginning. Customization is king—from unlocking powerful perks to randomized events, items, and vehicles that make each playthrough a fresh experience. You’ll also have control over world settings, adjusting everything to your playstyle—whether it’s tweaking difficulty, the day-night cycle, nuke timer, or the number of classified materials required to call the evacuation helicopter.

And don’t forget your loyal huskies! They’ll help you find hidden items, warn you of danger, and even fight off threats. But beware—they’re not immune to the virus, and neither are your teammates!

[b]Looking Ahead: New Maps, More Adventure[/b]

We’re committed to making Nuclear Nightmare a game that evolves with your feedback. This is only the start! In the coming months, we’ll be introducing new open-world maps that expand the lore while keeping the core gameplay intact. Up next: a forest-based map featuring boats, dirt bikes, and new enemies with distinct behaviors—all while keeping the same thrilling match type: collect the classified materials, avoid infection, and call the helicopter to escape.

Let us know what maps, features, and changes you’d like to see next! We want Nuclear Nightmare to evolve based on what our community wants.

[b]Join us in shaping the future of Nuclear Nightmare! The Arctic (and beyond) awaits… if you dare.[/b]
